name: multiple-errors-in-order
notes: Every field of entry 0 fails, entry 1 is not an object, and entry 2 repeats a branch; errors follow the documented order.

checkpoint.objective: Synthetic epic used by the planner_worktrees corpus.

expected_errors: Epic planner checkpoint planner_worktrees[0].branch must be a non-empty branch name.
Epic planner checkpoint planner_worktrees[0].path must be a repository-relative path without a drive, a leading slash, a backslash, or dot segments.
Epic planner checkpoint planner_worktrees[0].purpose must be preparation.
Epic planner checkpoint planner_worktrees[0].preparation_status must be one of: preparing, prepared, fanned_in, removed, abandoned.
Epic planner checkpoint planner_worktrees[0].feature_folder must name a features[] feature_folder.
Epic planner checkpoint planner_worktrees[0].recorded_at must be a non-empty string when present.
Epic planner checkpoint planner_worktrees[1] must be an object.
Epic planner checkpoint planner_worktrees[3].branch must be unique: feature/beta-2.
Epic planner checkpoint planner_worktrees[3].recorded_at must be a non-empty string when present.
